text: いそがしく　あちこちを　とびまわる。

patterns.name: 〜く
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く makes a word like いそがしい describe how an action is done. いそがしく = 'busily'.

patterns.name: 〜まわる
patterns.explanation: まわる added to a verb's stem means doing it all around the place. とびまわる = 'fly about'.

patterns.name: 〜を (place left or passed through)
patterns.span: あちこちを　とびまわる
patterns.explanation: With verbs of moving, を shows the area the movement goes through. あちこちを　とびまわる = 'flies around here and there'.
